Mod.Name: Friendly Progression
Mod.Author: Overgrowth Online
Mod.Description: Spend XP between campaign levels, Arena matches or Survival batteries. Injured fighters can buy a full recovery. Its price depends on the severity of their injuries. The maximum rises with completed levels, rounds or waves. The host can also enable free upgrades, including recovery, at checkpoints, Arena round ends and Survival battery clears. Each player's Luck affects their chance to get a choice and the value of the four upgrades offered. The host can give individual players committed XP on defeat and let local leaders choose that handicap for their own players. Saves keep handicaps, balances, equipment, Luck and pending choices with their lobby slots. Optional profile progression awards one token for every ten campaign levels cleared, ten Arena matches won or ten Survival batteries survived. Spend tokens on cosmetic or gameplay unlocks from Profiles or a lobby player entry. Gameplay unlocks contributed by the lobby are shared from map start.

LobbySetting.label: Progression
LobbySetting.description: Configure XP, the shop and free upgrades for this mode.

LobbySetting.label: XP shop
LobbySetting.description: Spend earned XP on upgrades after each completed campaign level, Arena match or Survival battery.

LobbySetting.label: Free upgrade choice
LobbySetting.description: At each new campaign checkpoint, Arena round end or Survival battery clear, each player has a chance to pick one of four free upgrades. Luck improves that chance and the odds of drawing expensive upgrades.

LobbySetting.label: Upgrades
LobbySetting.description: Buy upgrades independently or share them across a team.

LobbySetting.label: Gain XP for damage dealt
LobbySetting.description: Earn XP in proportion to the damage you deal to opponents.

LobbySetting.label: Gain XP for kills
LobbySetting.description: Earn an opponent's bounty when your team defeats them.

LobbySetting.label: Lose pooled XP on damage
LobbySetting.description: Taking damage reduces your unbanked XP, down to zero. With this enabled, combat XP banks when an Arena round or Survival wave ends.

LobbySetting.label: Lose XP on defeat
LobbySetting.description: Defeat spends pooled XP first. Any unpaid cost comes from committed XP. With this enabled, combat XP banks when an Arena round or Survival wave ends.

LobbySetting.label: Local leaders may set XP handicaps
LobbySetting.description: Let each computer's local leader choose which of its players earn committed XP when defeated. The host can always choose for any human slot.

LobbySetting.label: Gain XP at checkpoints
LobbySetting.description: Earn bonus XP for reaching a new campaign checkpoint.

LobbySetting.label: Gain XP for round wins
LobbySetting.description: Earn bonus XP when your team wins an Arena round or clears a Survival wave, including the final wave.

LobbySetting.label: Gain XP for match wins
LobbySetting.description: Earn bonus XP when your team wins an Arena match or clears a Survival battery.

LobbySetting.label: Multiplayer upgrade timer
LobbySetting.description: Set how long the multiplayer shop waits for players to finish shopping.
